newsitem.title: HONG KONG: PCI Bank closes 10 billion yen FRCD.
newsitem.headline: PCI Bank closes 10 billion yen FRCD.

text.p: Philippine Commercial International Bank's 10 billion yen floating rate certificates of deposit issue has closed, bankers said.
The five-year facility was priced at par to float at 75 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 80 basis points.
Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and DKB Asia are lead managers.

Other participating banks are ABN Amro, BA Asia, BT Asia, Chase Mahattan Asia, Fuji International Finance, HSBC Markets, ING Barings, Sanwa International Finance, Sakura Finance Asia, SBC Warburg and Societe Generale Asia.
